target_scope.statement: Let (Zt) be a nonnegative supermartingale with respect to Ft and tau a stopping time. Assume(i) Z0=k;(ii)|Z(t+1)-Zt|<=B for all t>=0;(iii) there is sigma^2>0 so that for every t, Var(Z(t+1)|Ft)>=sigma^2 on {tau>t}. If u>12B^2/sigma^2, then P_k{tau>u}<=4k/(sigma sqrt(u)).
target_scope.proof_end: QED at physical429 after D.26: P{tau>u}<=2sqrt(3)k/(sigma sqrt(u))<=4k/(sigma sqrt(u))
